mapper.sql: p.policy_id, p.subject_type, p.subject_id, p.quota_bytes, p.priority, p.expire_time, p.status, p.version, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark
mapper.select: select , '全员默认' as subject_name from drive_personal_quota_policy p where p.subject_type = 'GLOBAL' and p.subject_id = 0 and p.status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1

select , u.nick_name as subject_name from drive_personal_quota_policy p join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.subject_id where p.subject_type = 'USER' and p.subject_id = #{userId} and p.status = 'ACTIVE' and (p.expire_time is null or p.expire_time > #{now}) and u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' limit 1

select , post.post_name as subject_name from drive_personal_quota_policy p join sys_post post on post.post_id = p.subject_id and post.status = '0' join sys_user_post up on up.post_id = post.post_id and up.user_id = #{userId} where p.subject_type = 'POST' and p.status = 'ACTIVE' and (p.expire_time is null or p.expire_time > #{now}) order by p.priority desc, p.quota_bytes desc, p.policy_id asc

select , case p.subject_type when 'GLOBAL' then '全员默认' when 'POST' then post.post_name when 'USER' then coalesce(user.nick_name, user.user_name) else null end as subject_name from drive_personal_quota_policy p left join sys_post post on p.subject_type = 'POST' and post.post_id = p.subject_id left join sys_user user on p.subject_type = 'USER' and user.user_id = p.subject_id order by case p.subject_type when 'GLOBAL' then 0 when 'POST' then 1 else 2 end, p.priority desc, p.subject_id

select post.post_id as postId, post.post_code as postCode, post.post_name as postName, count(distinct case when u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' then up.user_id end) as userCount, case when policy.policy_id is null then false else true end as configured from sys_post post left join sys_user_post up on up.post_id = post.post_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = up.user_id left join drive_personal_quota_policy policy on policy.subject_type = 'POST' and policy.subject_id = post.post_id where post.status = '0' group by post.post_id, post.post_code, post.post_name, post.post_sort, policy.policy_id order by post.post_sort, post.post_id

select u.user_id as userId, u.user_name as userName, u.nick_name as nickName, d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, post.post_id as postId, post.post_name as postName from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = u.dept_id and d.status = '0' and d.del_flag = '0' left join sys_user_post up on up.user_id = u.user_id left join sys_post post on post.post_id = up.post_id and post.status = '0' where u.status = '0' and u.del_flag = '0' order by u.user_id, post.post_sort, post.post_id
select count(*) from sys_user where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
select count(*) from sys_post where post_id = #{postId} and status = '0'
